Browser translation runtime: @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 (MIT)
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
Corresponding licenses are included in this directory.

Optional models, downloaded separately by the user:
onnx-community/whisper-small and onnx-community/whisper-base
https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-small
https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-base
Converted from OpenAI Whisper (MIT), used here for Japanese speech only.
https://github.com/openai/whisper
Legacy Kotoba model caches are no longer downloaded by the phone trial.
onnx-community/Qwen3-1.7B-ONNX (Apache-2.0)
https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Qwen3-1.7B-ONNX
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
Xenova/opus-mt-ja-en, Xenova/opus-mt-fr-en, Xenova/opus-mt-en-zh
Based on Helsinki-NLP's corresponding OPUS-MT models (Apache-2.0).
https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-ja-en
https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-fr-en
https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-zh
The worker pins exact model revisions. Generated text may contain errors.
Audio and transcript text are never sent to the model host.
Model files are not included in the published repository or website.
The 22 MB ONNX WASM binary is downloaded from jsDelivr's pinned npm package
on first use, SHA-256 verified, and cached separately for reuse.
